mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 1.3% is historically low, and we are always in a low-rate environment, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is at 1.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an imminent monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate above 2.0% and CPIAUCSL above 250 signal a dual threat of monetary tightening and accelerating inflation, which increases risk premiums and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS>2.0% and CPIAUCSL>250.

mechanism_narrative: When the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by GDPC1 above 17000 and UNRATE below 4.5%), the S&P 500 is expected to have positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence in the economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1>17000 and UNRATE<4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which increases recession risk and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP (GDPC1 above 17000) and housing starts (HOUST above 1200) signal a robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1>17000 and HOUST>1200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 147000 signals a weakening labor market, which increases recession risk and reduces consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS falls below 147000.
